newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus opens first telecoms satellite link.
newsitem.headline: Belarus opens first telecoms satellite link.

text.p: The former Soviet republic of Belarus opened its first satellite station link-up on Friday.
"This will put Belarus on a level with world standards in terms of telephone and television communications," Deputy Minister of Communications and Information Anatoly Buday said.

The "Inter-Sputnik" station, based 30 km (18 miles) from the capital Minsk, connected Belarus with India, Buday said. A second link to be opened this month would link Belarus with the U.S. and Israel, he said.
The equipment for the two stations, worth $3 million, was supplied by a U.S. company Revcom, Georgiy Grinevetski, another senior ministry official, said.
The ministry was seeking joint-venture partners for another five satellite stations, he added.
